about: Lane SIG12 (2026-11-27): birds whose own sleep text has them roosting afloat on open water at night (`behaviour-schedule.ts` rawRoostOf: the night's roost on the nearest open water's surface, never a roof or the grass; drawn at its float line, the water's own way, `index.ts` fromSchedule). Each with the field and the sentence it comes from.

black-headed-gull.quote: In the evening birds fly in long lines to roost communally on open water such as reservoirs, lakes and estuaries, resting afloat or on mudbanks until dawn.
